name: Kevin Wang
description: A little about Kevin Wang: statistics, writing, and places along the way.

timeline.title: Data Science Intern
timeline.description: Working on usage-based insurance and telematics, looking at how people drive. Most people with our app drive like my mom: very cautious.

timeline.title: MS in Statistics
timeline.description: Continuing my studies in statistics, with coursework in statistical theory, time series, and machine learning. So far, ate a lot of free food.

timeline.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
timeline.description: Studied how sports injuries affect performance using Bayesian models in R and Stan. Still couldn't tell me when I could play basketball again after my back injury.

timeline.title: A semester in Beijing
timeline.description: Spent a semester on exchange at Tsinghua, where I reconnected with culture. Made new friends, played some sports, ripped Mahjong, explored lots, and occasionally studied.

timeline.title: Actuarial Automation Intern
timeline.description: Built VBA tools to automate insurance policy illustrations and data entry. Made my actuarial teammates happy.

timeline.title: Actuarial Data Analytics Intern
timeline.description: Worked on claims forecasting and reporting using regression, SQL, and Power BI. Drank Bubly constantly.

timeline.title: BS in Statistics & Computer Science
timeline.description: Studied statistics and computer science, with a minor in management. Along the way: hackathons, course grading, a touch of research, and consistently losing in the playoffs in intramural basketball.

timeline.title: Artificial Intelligence Research Intern
timeline.description: Worked on educational AI and predictive analytics with two profs. Helped them gather some data; they seemed pleased.

interests.title: Sports
interests.text: Basketball, hockey, football, and swimming. I used to play more, but these days I mostly watch from the couch.

interests.title: Around a table
interests.text: Catan, chess, poker, and mahjong. Some friends think they’re better than me at Catan; they’re delusional.

interests.title: Books & words
interests.text: I like to read before bed and write occasionally. Some thoughts make it online; the rest stay in my head.
